caption:
Three things beginners are scared of that Instagram has confirmed are fine:

→ Scheduling posts. Mosseri confirmed it does not hurt reach. Post when you can plan it, not when you can be awake.

→ Editing in another app. Third-party editors like CapCut don't cost you reach, as long as there's no watermark. The watermark is the problem, not the app.

→ Labelling paid partnerships. Marking a post "Sponsored" does not harm visibility. Disclose with confidence.

Every one of these myths costs real money. People wake up at 6am to post manually, avoid tools that would make their content better, and hide partnerships in ways that get them in trouble — all to appease a rule that doesn't exist.

The pattern is worth noticing: almost every "the algorithm punishes X" claim you'll hear is from someone selling the solution to X.

When in doubt, check Mosseri's own account. He answers this stuff directly.
